name: completion enumerates a lexicographically ordered subtree
input: overlapping words with an exact-prefix word
test:
trie = PrefixTrie(['dog', 'door', 'do', 'dove', 'cat'])
assert trie.complete('do') == ['do', 'dog', 'door', 'dove']
assert trie.complete('doo') == ['door']
assert trie.contains('do') is True
assert trie.contains('d') is False

name: duplicates empty-prefix enumeration and misses are deterministic
input: a duplicate word and a prefix absent from the trie
test:
trie = PrefixTrie()
for word in ('b', 'ant', 'a', 'ant'):
    trie.insert(word)
assert trie.complete('') == ['a', 'ant', 'b']
assert trie.complete('z') == []
assert trie.complete('an') == ['ant']

name: invalid words and prefixes fail explicitly
